title: Oven-Roasted Jammy Dutch Bread Bowl
description: A fluffy, jam-filled bread bowl baked in a stone dolsot, made with rapeseed oil and a long-fermentation dough, perfect for a jain-friendly indulgence.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, salt, and sugar until evenly mixed.
In a separate bowl, dissolve the yeast in the warm water and let stand for 10 minutes until frothy.
Pour the yeast mixture and rapeseed oil into the dry ingredients, mixing until a shaggy dough forms.
Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Transfer the dough to a greased bowl, cover with a cloth, and let it bulk ferment at room temperature for 3 hours.
After fermentation, punch down the dough, shape it into a round, and place it in a greased dolsot stone bowl; cover and let proof for 1 hour.
Preheat the oven to 200°C; bake the bread bowl for 25 minutes until golden brown.
Remove from the oven, let it cool for 5 minutes, then fill the interior with strawberry jam and sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving warm.
